title: Astrid and the Interior
author: Lior Iversen
blurb: Isandro Zhou, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
